data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hippos', meaning 'horse'. In ancient Greek culture, the horse represented power, strength, and speed. The name Hippel was given to warriors and nobles, reflecting their courageous and noble character. The name Hippel carries the meaning “Horse, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hippel usually hope their child will grow to embody horse, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hippel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
